svg.text: The whole sky seen from the ship: at rest and at 0.9 c (600 catalogue stars)
beta = 0.9: stars crowd ahead, bluer; behind, sparse and red
ahead 573 of 600 stars (expected 570); dashed ring: half of all stars
Centre: the direction of motion; rim: straight behind; rings every 30 deg. Dot size: visible-band flux; colour: the black body at D T.
